c/aes.observation: The upstream million-block benchmark discards its final ciphertext. Lean, CompCert and GCC disassembly retain the rijndaelEncrypt call inside the counted loop.

c/sha1.observation: The upstream 200000-block benchmark discards the final digest. All three executables retain the SHA1_add_data loop and SHA1_finish call.

c/sha3.observation: The upstream timed digests are discarded. All three executables retain 25 keccak calls over the 100000-byte buffer.

c/siphash24.observation: main discards speed_test's result. All three executables retain its million-iteration crypto_auth loop; no workload-removal speedup is claimed.
